Replaces multiSig; callable only by the current multiSig (onlyMultiSig).

IPriceOracles entry point returning (price, valid) and delegating to getChainLinkPrice when a mapping exists.

Admin-only setter for the BNB/USD reference aggregator address.

Admin-only batch setter looping over token/chainlink arrays (length checked).

Admin-only batch setter for direct-call flags.
Pure helper detecting native-coin sentinel addresses (0xEeee..., 0x0, 0xbBb...) for the direct ETH/BNB price path.
Core pricing routine: picks reference aggregator, calls latestAnswer on chainlink contracts and scales results with SafeMath.
Returns price plus updatedAt timestamps from chainlink latestRoundData, taking the older of the two timestamps; no staleness/validity check.
Batch view aggregating getLatestRoundData for an array of tokens into a ChainlinkPrice[].
Empty payable receive function accepting native coin transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for admin/multiSig authorisation and stored as admin during initialization.
External call to AggregatorInterface.latestAnswer() on an arbitrary admin-supplied oracle; returned price is trusted without sanity checks.
External call to latestRoundData() whose updatedAt is returned to callers without being validated against block.timestamp (stale-price risk).
SafeMath scaling of oracle answers (mul(1e10), mul(tokenPrice).div(1e8)); int256->uint256 casts and scaling are price-manipulation sensitive.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored directly as admin during initialize; whoever front-runs initialization becomes admin.
onlyMultiSig gate compares msg.sender with multiSig before writing multiSig.
onlyMultiSig gate compares msg.sender with multiSig before replacing admin.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards the ETH/USD oracle setter.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards the BNB/USD oracle setter.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards token=>aggregator mapping writes.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards the batch mapping writer.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards direct-call flag writes.
onlyAdmin gate on msg.sender guards the batch flag writer.
initialize assigns the supplied address to multiSig.
initialize sets admin = msg.sender with no additional authorisation beyond the initializer guard.
setMultiSig overwrites the multiSig state variable.
setAdmin overwrites the privileged admin state variable.
Admin-writable oracle address determines every ETH-side price returned.
Admin-writable oracle address determines every BNB-side price returned.
setTokenChainlinkMap writes the token=>chainlink entry.
setTokenChainlinkMaps loops and delegates each entry to setTokenChainlinkMap.
setDirectTokenMap writes the direct-call flag.
setDirectTokenMaps writes the direct-call flag for every token in the batch.
get() delegates to getChainLinkPrice when a chainlink mapping is registered.
get() reads tokenChainlinkMap to decide whether a price can be served.
getChainLinkPrice reads tokenChainlinkMap to build the aggregator instance.
getChainLinkPrice reads directTokenMap to choose the USD-direct or cross-price path.
getChainLinkPrice reads ethToUsdPriceOracle as reference aggregator.
getChainLinkPrice reads bnbToUsdPriceOracle as reference aggregator.
getChainLinkPrice uses isEthOrBnB to short-circuit native-coin pricing.
getChainLinkPrice takes its price from chainlink latestAnswer calls.
Returned price is computed with SafeMath mul/div scaling of int256 oracle answers.
getLatestRoundData reads the base price via latestAnswer.
getLatestRoundData reads updatedAt from latestRoundData on the reference and token aggregators.
getLatestRoundData branches on isEthOrBnB.
getLatestRoundData scales oracle answers with mul(1e10) / mul(tokenPrice).div(1e8).
getLatestRoundData reads tokenChainlinkMap for the token aggregator.
getLatestRoundData reads directTokenMap to select the direct USD path.
getLatestRoundData reads ethToUsdPriceOracle.
getLatestRoundData reads bnbToUsdPriceOracle.
gets() loops over the token array calling getLatestRoundData for each entry.
Untrusted admin-configured aggregator contract returns the price that getChainLinkPrice blindly trusts and forwards.
Aggregator-provided updatedAt is returned to consumers without comparing it to block.timestamp, enabling stale-price reliance.
initialize consumes _multiSig and stores it into multiSig.
setMultiSig consumes _multiSig.
setAdmin consumes _admin.
get() forwards the requested token to getChainLinkPrice.
setEthToUsdPriceOracle stores its argument.
setBnbToUsdPriceOracle stores its argument.

setTokenChainlinkMap uses chainlink as the stored aggregator address.
setTokenChainlinkMaps iterates the tokens array.
setTokenChainlinkMaps iterates the chainlinks array.
setDirectTokenMap keys the flag by token.
setDirectTokenMap stores the direct boolean.
setDirectTokenMaps iterates the tokens array.
setDirectTokenMaps applies the direct boolean to all tokens.
isEthOrBnB compares the supplied token with native-coin sentinel addresses.
getChainLinkPrice resolves the aggregator using the requested token.
getLatestRoundData resolves aggregators using the requested token.
gets() sizes and fills its output array from the tokens parameter.
referenceOracle selects the aggregator used for the base price inside getChainLinkPrice.
chainlinkContract is the externally called aggregator instance.
basePrice is assigned from the latestAnswer return value.
basePrice is multiplied by 1e10 or by tokenPrice before being returned as uint256.
tokenPrice is assigned from the token aggregator's latestAnswer.
tokenPrice participates in the mul/div price combination and int256->uint256 casts.
updatedAt is assigned from the reference aggregator's latestRoundData.
updatedAt1 is assigned from the token aggregator's latestRoundData.
latest selects the older timestamp and is returned to the caller.
res is the freshly allocated ChainlinkPrice result array returned by gets().
n bounds the loop that repeatedly calls getLatestRoundData on untrusted aggregators.
loop index i selects each token for getLatestRoundData.
